text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — multiple POPs in us-west4 are reporting high packet loss to our CDN edges. Detected at 2026-03-15T14:33Z. Aggregated loss ~12% over 60s for egress -> client paths.

alice: seeing customer error spike on hosted API from west coast customers. 5xxs up ~8% vs baseline. Not all routes.

lin: traceroutes show intermittent drops after our POP egress, looks like last-mile carrier flapping. Sending initial traceroute sample.
```
traceroute to 34.120.45.7 (34.120.45.7), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms  0.4 ms  0.4 ms
 2  192.0.2.5  1.2 ms  1.1 ms  1.3 ms
 3  * * *
 4  198.51.100.77  20.4 ms  35.1 ms  22.8 ms
 5  34.120.45.7  23.0 ms  21.7 ms  22.2 ms
```

arnold: paging oncall to @arnold — can you takeover? I'm going to open a ticket with carrier & CDN vendor.

arnold: on it. joining bridge now. Link: https://call.example.com/meet/incident-2030456789

jess: customer-reported: "unable to reach inference endpoints intermittently from SFO" — logged two support tickets (CS-4589, CS-4591). Will update with severity.

maria: confirming product impact: Hosted API (text-generation) has increased latency and ~8% request error rate for sessions pinned to us-west4 POPs. Dedicated customers on reserved pools in other regions unaffected.

alice: immediate mitigations: 1) enable emergency DNS steer to redirect traffic away from affected POPs, 2) increase cache TTL fallback and 3) enable model fallback to smaller variant for latency-sensitive customers. Lin, arnold — can you execute steer and BGP changes?

lin: starting DNS steer. Lowered TTL for edge A-records to 30s, initiating weighted failover to us-west2 and us-west3 with 70/30 split away from affected nodes.

lin: issuing BGP local-prepend on affected peering to make backup paths preferred. Command pushed to router group rg-edge-027: `bgp prepend 3` — propagating.

arnold: verifying routing change — observed decreased traffic to POP us-west4 edge nodes within 90s. Dropped QPS to node group down ~60%. 5xxs trending down.

sre-bot: Incident status update: mitigation in progress. Customer impact reduced from 8% 5xx to ~2% 5xx in region. Continue monitoring for full recovery.

jess: notifying impacted customers (prefix) with initial incident advisory. Template used: "We are investigating intermittent connectivity to endpoints from certain US-West locations; we have mitigations in place. Next update in 30 minutes."

maria: deploy-bot shows no concurrent infra deploys in region. `deploy-bot: No active deploys in last 30m`

lin: carrier replied — they see DDoS-like microbursts on peering link causing hardware queue drops during bursts. They are applying shaping and will run interface diagnostics. ETA initial remediation 20-30m.

arnold: temp workaround: we enabled sticky routing off for affected customers so sessions will not be forced back to bad POP on reconnects. That reduced errors on persistent sessions.

alice: good. start timeline note: 14:33Z detection, 14:35Z pages sent, 14:38Z DNS TTL set, 14:40Z BGP prepend, 14:42Z customer advisory posted.

sre-bot: Added incident channel pinned message and created incident record: INC-2030456789. Severity: S2 (regional partial outage).

arnold: heading into deep-dive with carrier + CDN vendor. Lin — keep the steer active until they confirm stable link. If packetloss persists beyond 45m we escalate to full POP drain and failover (larger DNS weight shift).

lin: agreed. monitoring graphs: packet loss reduced to ~4% after carrier shaping. Still seeing microbursts causing tail latency.

jess: CS updated customers with carrier status and estimated next update at 15:10Z.

maria: action items for postmortem: - confirm root cause (carrier hardware queue issues) - evaluate automatic fallback thresholds for DNS/BGP steer - test sticky-routing impacts on session continuity - update runbook for edge last-mile incidents.

alice: who will own postmortem? arnold take lead, maria co-author, lin provide network logs. Jess will collate customer impact.

arnold: I’ll own PM. Will gather BGP dumps, netflow, and traceroutes. Targeting PM draft within 48h.

sre-bot: Note: handoff scheduled — alice handing off to arnold for next 3h oncall. Please react with :thumbsup: to acknowledge.

alice: handing off. arnold, all yours.

arnold: acknow — taking over. continuing monitoring and liaising with carrier/CDN. I’ll post a status update every 15m or on any regression.

sre-bot: Final status update (15:25Z): carrier reports clearing hardware queue issues; packet loss <=1% sustained for 10m. Gradual rollback of DNS steer to normal weights starting now. No further customer escalations in queue. Marking incident as mitigated; will remain in monitoring for 1h before resolve.

jess: closing CS-4591, leaving CS-4589 open pending customer confirmation.

maria: thanks team. Please ensure all logs/commands referenced are uploaded to INC-2030456789 ticket in the incident tracker.

arnold: will attach BGP config snippets, netflow and carrier comms. closing handoff note — monitoring until 16:25Z then will mark resolved if stable.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2030456789 status: Mitigated -> Monitoring.
